title: [2.8.2.10-dev] Wrong Basal IOB in CALCULATOR Button (if Extended bolus is running ?)
symptom: When opening the Calculator multiple times while an extended bolus is running, the proposed bolus calculation varies significantly between dialogs, and the basal IOB values are inconsistent and not matching the detailed IOB screenshot.
cause: The thread identifies that there is an issue in IOB calculation for the contribution of a running Extended TBR, and the maintainer states it was not one bug but two, fixed by a commit.
fix: The fix was implemented in commit 8bac46830641a36934813d16b98d5413723baff3, which addressed the two bugs in the IOB calculation.
evidence_quote: it was not one bug but two :( fixed by https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/commit/8bac46830641a36934813d16b98d5413723baff3
